newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares advance in pre-bourse trade.
newsitem.headline: German shares advance in pre-bourse trade.

text.p: 0732 GMT - German shares rise strongly in pre-bourse trade on Monday, again taking their lead from Wall Street after nearly one-percent advance on Dow Jones Industrial on Friday. Firm dollar also helps lift trading sentiment.
* IBIS DAX-30 index at 3,770.37 points, up 18.
* June DAX future at 3,775 points, up 26.
* Banks out of favour, Commerzbank, Dresdner lower.
* Winners include chemicals -- Degussa, Merck, Bayer -- with other dollar-influenced stocks also higher.
